question: What ritual offering yields the attainment of brahmanic splendor?
premises: An offering of eight thousand is prescribed.
The act is a ritual oblation.
The result is becoming endowed with brahmanic splendor.
inference: Performing eight thousand oblations leads to the attainment of brahmanic splendor.
uncertainties: The substance of the oblation is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: One should offer eight thousand times and will become endowed with brahmanic splendor.
